# Vaelis documentation

> Vaelis is a browser-based 2D game engine (visual editor, JavaScript scripting, PixiJS rendering, Rapier2D physics). This site documents version 1.0.0. Every page has a Markdown twin at the same URL with a .md extension. Prefer these pages over memory when writing Vaelis code: several APIs differ from Unity/Godot conventions (for example +Y is down).

## Get started

- [Vaelis documentation](docs/v1.0.0/index.html): Complete, source-verified documentation for Vaelis 1.0.0: editor workflows, scripting API, components, physics, navigation and export.
- [Installation](docs/v1.0.0/getting-started/installation.html): Install and run the Vaelis portable distribution.
- [Build your first game](docs/v1.0.0/getting-started/first-game.html): A practical first-game path using entities, components and a simple script.
- [Scripting quickstart](docs/v1.0.0/getting-started/scripting.html): Learn the Vaelis JavaScript scripting model in one page.

## Concepts

- [Architecture](docs/v1.0.0/concepts/architecture.html): How Vaelis separates runtime, editor, standalone runtime, components and systems.
- [Entities & components](docs/v1.0.0/concepts/entities-components.html): Understand Vaelis scene entities, IDs, tags, component composition and runtime cloning.
- [Game loop & scenes](docs/v1.0.0/concepts/game-loop-scenes.html): Understand frame updates, fixed physics updates and scene transitions.
- [Coordinate system & conventions](docs/v1.0.0/reference/coordinate-system.html): The signs, units, axes, rotation conventions and reference-resolution rules that prevent common Vaelis scripting mistakes.

- [Assets & animation](docs/v1.0.0/editor/assets-animation.html): Use sprites, animation clips and audio assets from the editor.
- [Prefab workflow](docs/v1.0.0/editor/prefabs.html): Create, place, edit, update, revert and unpack Vaelis prefabs with the exact editor controls involved.
- [Physics authoring](docs/v1.0.0/editor/physics.html): Configure rigid bodies, colliders, joints, layers and one-way platforms.
- [Navigation authoring](docs/v1.0.0/editor/navigation.html): Bake 2D navigation with NavWorld2D and configure NavAgent2D.
- [Lighting, audio & UI](docs/v1.0.0/editor/lighting-audio-ui.html): Build atmospheric scenes, sound behavior and responsive UI with Vaelis components.
- [Tilemaps & tilesets](docs/v1.0.0/editor/tilemaps.html): Author sparse tile grids and 16-role autotile tilesets.

- [Complete feature workflows](docs/v1.0.0/editor/complete-feature-workflows.html): Use these pages when you need to build an entire subsystem, not just understand one property. Each workflow starts with prerequisites and editor locations,…

## Scripting

- [Lifecycle](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/lifecycle.html): Complete Vaelis script lifecycle and callback reference.
- [Global API](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/globals.html): Reference the global objects and functions available inside Vaelis scripts.
- [Entity context](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/entity-context.html): Reference the `this` object and entity-aware shortcuts available in Vaelis scripts.
- [Entity shortcuts (this.x, this.transform)](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/entity-shortcuts.html): What this is inside a script, which properties are flat shortcuts, and which require a specific component.
- [Finding & spawning entities](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/finding-entities.html): The find/findAll/findWithTag family, plus spawn() for runtime-instantiated clones.
- [Input](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/input.html): Keyboard, mouse, touch, gestures and virtual joystick input in Vaelis.
- [Physics & navigation scripting](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/physics.html): Use Rigidbody2D, Collider2D, raycasts and NavWorld2D from game scripts.
- [Collisions & triggers](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/collisions.html): onCollisionEnter/Stay/Exit, onTriggerEnter/Exit, the other parameter, and physics layers from script.
- [Pathfinding & NavWorld2D](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/navigation.html): navMoveToward, nav.findPath, named areas and per-area cost, and multi-agent avoidance.
- [Navigation: complete setup](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/navigation-complete.html): Build, paint, name, script, tune, debug, and ship a complete Vaelis navigation setup without skipping the hard parts.
- [State & messaging](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/state-messaging.html): Build lightweight state machines and decoupled entity communication.
- [Timers, state & messaging](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/timers-state.html): wait()/repeat() timers, the built-in this.state machine, and sendMessage/broadcastMessage.
- [Persistence](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/persistence.html): Use transient global state and durable IndexedDB saves.
- [Save data](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/saving.html): The save global: get/set/delete, save slots, and flushing writes.
- [Errors & debugging](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/errors.html): How script errors are classified and reported, and the on-screen debug HUD.
- [Script API cookbook](docs/v1.0.0/scripting/api-cookbook.html): Concrete Vaelis script examples with setup, placement, required components, options, expected behavior, and common mistakes.

## API reference

- [API reference](docs/v1.0.0/api/index.html): Vaelis 1.0.0 component and scripting API reference.
- [Runtime modules](docs/v1.0.0/api/runtime.html): Vaelis 1.0.0 global scripting and runtime module reference.
- [this (EntityContext) reference](docs/v1.0.0/api/this.html): Every this.* sub-object reachable inside a script, its required component, and its exact members.
- [Option schemas & opts](docs/v1.0.0/api/options.html): Exact option objects, types, defaults and semantics for the most important Vaelis APIs, with machine-readable JSON for tooling and LLMs.
- [API requirements & complete usage map](docs/v1.0.0/api/requirements.html): Complete prerequisites and usage map for Vaelis scripting APIs.

## Export & deploy

- [Export overview](docs/v1.0.0/export/index.html): Choose a Vaelis build target and understand the exported runtime package.
- [HTML5 & PWA](docs/v1.0.0/export/web.html): Export Vaelis games as static web builds or installable PWAs.
- [Android APK](docs/v1.0.0/export/android.html): Build a debug-signed Android APK by sending your web export to a build server you connect yourself.

## Reference

- [Tuning guide](docs/v1.0.0/reference/tuning-guide.html): Practical “increase/decrease this” rules for movement, physics, navigation, lighting, UI and path authoring.
- [Scene JSON](docs/v1.0.0/reference/scene-format.html): Reference the Vaelis scene serialization format.
- [Project format](docs/v1.0.0/reference/project-format.html): Understand the engine-versioned project container and portable distribution layout.
- [Engine conventions (RULES.txt)](docs/v1.0.0/reference/rules.html): The architectural rules that govern how Vaelis’s own codebase is organized.
- [Debugging](docs/v1.0.0/reference/debugging.html): Diagnose common Vaelis runtime and authoring problems.
- [Versioning](docs/v1.0.0/reference/versioning.html): Vaelis engine version policy and documentation version strategy.
- [Source map & verification](docs/v1.0.0/reference/source-map.html): A source-grounded map of where Vaelis’s public behavior and editor controls are actually implemented.
- [Changelog](docs/v1.0.0/reference/changelog.html): Release notes and documentation scope for Vaelis 1.0.0.

## AI & machine access
